name: WireGuard
author: tsmithscott
description: WireGuard tunnel status, live speed and traffic stats, peer handshakes, and one-click toggles in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Toggle WireGuard tunnels, watch throughput, and inspect peers.

schema.label: Look up public IP automatically
schema.description: Asks ipinfo.io for your exit address when the panel opens (at most once a minute) and whenever a tunnel goes up or down.

schema.label: Offer peer stats setup
schema.description: Show the "Enable peer stats" button (needs your password once).

schema.label: Default tunnel
schema.description: Tunnel the master switch and right-click bring up. Empty uses the last one you connected.

schema.label: One tunnel at a time
schema.description: Bringing a tunnel up takes all the others down. When off, a full tunnel (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0) still replaces another full tunnel; split tunnels run side by side.

schema.label: Hide interfaces
schema.description: Comma-separated. wt0 is NetBird's interface, which has its own widget.

schema.label: wg-quick configs
schema.description: Comma-separated names from /etc/wireguard (without .conf). Toggled through pkexec.
